parts.zh: Arkansas州女子Kelly Swisher在高速公路上驾车时
M: 真的吗？你从没说过你要去泰国
M: 没有，我真希望来过
W: 嗯，我昨天遇到了一个德国来的人
W: 是的。我还交了一个新的小朋友
M: 嗯，等你回来可以把这些都告诉我

items.stem: How did Kelly Swisher feel when she first came across the rat snake?

choices.text: Annoyed.
choices.zh: 恼怒的。

choices.text: Scared.
choices.zh: 害怕的。

choices.text: Confused.
choices.zh: 困惑的。

choices.text: Offended.
choices.zh: 被冒犯的。

items.stem: What does the report say about the snake?

choices.text: It crawled over the woman's hands.
choices.zh: 它爬过了那位女士的手。

choices.text: It wound up on the steering wheel.
choices.zh: 它最终缠到了方向盘上。

choices.text: It was killed by the police on the spot.
choices.zh: 它被警察当场打死了。

choices.text: It was covered with large scales.
choices.zh: 它身上覆盖着大片的鳞片。

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: A study of the fast-food service.
choices.zh: 一项关于快餐服务的研究。

choices.text: Fast food customer satisfaction.
choices.zh: 快餐顾客满意度。

choices.text: McDonald's new business strategies.
choices.zh: McDonald's的新商业策略。

choices.text: Competition in the fast-food industry.
choices.zh: 快餐行业的竞争。

items.stem: What has slowed down McDonald's drive-through service?

choices.text: Customers' higher demands.
choices.zh: 顾客更高的要求。

choices.text: The inefficiency of employees.
choices.zh: 员工的低效率。

choices.text: Increased variety of products.
choices.zh: 产品种类的增加。

choices.text: The rising number of customers.
choices.zh: 顾客数量的增加。

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: International treaties regarding space travel programs.
choices.zh: 关于太空旅行项目的国际条约。

choices.text: Legal issues involved in commercial space exploration.
choices.zh: 商业太空探索所涉及的法律问题。

choices.text: U.S. government's approval of private space missions.
choices.zh: 美国政府对私人太空任务的批准。

choices.text: Competition among public and private space companies.
choices.zh: 公共和私人太空公司之间的竞争。

items.stem: What is Moon Express planning to do?

choices.text: Deliver scientific equipment to the moon.
choices.zh: 向月球运送科学设备。

choices.text: Approve a new mission to travel into outer space.
choices.zh: 批准一项前往外太空的新任务。

choices.text: Work with federal agencies on space programs.
choices.zh: 与联邦机构合作开展太空项目。

choices.text: Launch a manned spacecraft to Mars.
choices.zh: 发射载人航天器前往火星。

items.stem: What does Moon Express think of its mission?

choices.text: It is significant.
choices.zh: 它是重要的。

choices.text: It is promising.
choices.zh: 它是有前景的。

choices.text: It is unpredictable.
choices.zh: 它是不可预测的。

choices.text: It is unprofitable.
choices.zh: 它是无利可图的。

items.stem: What does the woman say she is doing now?

choices.text: Visiting her family in Thailand.
choices.zh: 在泰国探望家人。

choices.text: Showing friends around Phuket.
choices.zh: 带朋友游览普吉岛。

choices.text: Swimming around a Thai island.
choices.zh: 在泰国某个岛屿周围游泳。

choices.text: Lying in the sun on a Thai beach.
choices.zh: 躺在泰国海滩上晒太阳。

items.stem: What did the woman do yesterday?

choices.text: She visited a Thai orphanage.
choices.zh: 她参观了一家泰国孤儿院。

choices.text: She met a Thai girl's parents.
choices.zh: 她见了一位泰国女孩的父母。

choices.text: She learned some Thai words.
choices.zh: 她学了一些泰语单词。

choices.text: She sunbathed on a Thai beach.
choices.zh: 她在泰国海滩上晒了太阳。

items.stem: Why does the man have to end the conversation?

choices.text: His class will start in a minute.
choices.zh: 他的课程马上就要开始了。

choices.text: He has got an incoming phone call.
choices.zh: 他接到一个来电。

choices.text: Someone is knocking at his door.
choices.zh: 有人在敲他的门。

choices.text: His phone is running out of power.
choices.zh: 他的手机快没电了。

items.stem: Why does the man ask the woman to bring him something from Thailand?

choices.text: He is interested in Thai artworks.
choices.zh: 他对泰国艺术品感兴趣。

choices.text: He is going to open a souvenir shop.
choices.zh: 他打算开一家纪念品商店。

choices.text: He collects things from different countries.
choices.zh: 他收集来自不同国家的物品。

choices.text: He wants to know more about Thai culture.
choices.zh: 他想更多地了解泰国文化。

items.stem: What are the speakers talking about?

choices.text: Buying some fitness equipment for the new gym.
choices.zh: 为新健身房购买一些健身器材。

choices.text: Opening a gym and becoming personal trainers.
choices.zh: 开一家健身房并成为私人教练。

choices.text: Signing up for a weight-loss course.
choices.zh: 报名参加减肥课程。

choices.text: Trying out a new gym in town.
choices.zh: 试用镇上一家新开的健身房。

items.stem: What does the gym offer at its opening?

choices.text: Professional personal training.
choices.zh: 专业的私人训练。

choices.text: Free exercise for the first week.
choices.zh: 第一周免费锻炼。

choices.text: A discount for a half-year membership.
choices.zh: 半年会员资格的折扣。

choices.text: Additional benefits for young couples.
choices.zh: 为年轻夫妇提供额外福利。

items.stem: What is the man concerned about?

choices.text: The safety of weight-lifting.
choices.zh: 举重的安全性。

choices.text: The high membership fee.
choices.zh: 高昂的会员费。

choices.text: The renewal of his membership.
choices.zh: 他的会员资格续费。

choices.text: The operation of fitness equipment.
choices.zh: 健身器材的操作。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?

choices.text: She wants her invitation renewed.
choices.zh: 她想续订她的邀请。

choices.text: She used to do 200 sit-ups every day.
choices.zh: 她曾经每天做200个仰卧起坐。

choices.text: She knows the basics of weight-lifting.
choices.zh: 她了解举重的基本知识。

choices.text: She used to be the gym's personal trainer.
choices.zh: 她曾经是这家健身房的私人教练。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about today's jobseekers?

choices.text: They tend to be nervous during interviews.
choices.zh: 他们在面试时往往会紧张。

choices.text: They often apply for a number of positions.
choices.zh: 他们常常申请多个职位。

choices.text: They worry about the results of their applications.
choices.zh: 他们担心申请的结果。

choices.text: They search extensively for employers' information.
choices.zh: 他们广泛搜索雇主的信息。

items.stem: What can job applicants do with the help of Google?

choices.text: Get better organized.
choices.zh: 更好地组织安排。

choices.text: Edit their references.
choices.zh: 编辑他们的推荐信。

choices.text: Find better-paid jobs.
choices.zh: 找到薪酬更高的工作。

choices.text: Analyze the searching process.
choices.zh: 分析搜索过程。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest job seekers do?

choices.text: Provide their data in detail.
choices.zh: 详细提供他们的资料。

choices.text: Personalize each application.
choices.zh: 使每份申请个性化。

choices.text: Make use of better search engines.
choices.zh: 使用更好的搜索引擎。

choices.text: Apply for more promising positions.
choices.zh: 申请更有前景的职位。

items.stem: What are some people worried about according to the speaker?

choices.text: If kids did not like school, real learning would not take place.
choices.zh: 如果孩子们不喜欢学校,真正的学习就不会发生。

choices.text: If not forced to go to school, kids would be out in the streets.
choices.zh: 如果不被强制去上学,孩子们就会流落街头。

choices.text: If schools stayed the way they are, parents were sure to protest.
choices.zh: 如果学校维持现状,家长们肯定会抗议。

choices.text: If teaching failed to improve, kids would stay away from school.
choices.zh: 如果教学不能改善,孩子们就会远离学校。

items.stem: What does the speaker think we could do for the kids who dislike school?

choices.text: Allow them to play interesting games in class.
choices.zh: 允许他们在课堂上玩有趣的游戏。

choices.text: Try to stir up their interest in lab experiments.
choices.zh: 试图激发他们对实验室实验的兴趣。

choices.text: Let them stay home and learn from their parents.
choices.zh: 让他们待在家里向父母学习。

choices.text: Design activities they now enjoy doing on holidays.
choices.zh: 设计他们现在在假期喜欢做的活动。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is the easier thing we could do?

choices.text: Allow kids to learn at their own pace.
choices.zh: 允许孩子们按照自己的节奏学习。

choices.text: Encourage kids to learn from each other.
choices.zh: 鼓励孩子们互相学习。

choices.text: Organize kids into various interest groups.
choices.zh: 把孩子们组织成各种兴趣小组。

choices.text: Take kids out of school to learn at first hand.
choices.zh: 带孩子们走出学校进行第一手学习。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the dance in America?

choices.text: It is especially popular in Florida and Alaska.
choices.zh: 它在佛罗里达州和阿拉斯加州尤其流行。

choices.text: It is a major social activity among the young.
choices.zh: 它是年轻人中的一项主要社交活动。

choices.text: It is seen almost anywhere and on any occasion.
choices.zh: 它几乎在任何地方、任何场合都能看到。

choices.text: It is even more expressive than the written word.
choices.zh: 它甚至比书面文字更具表现力。

items.stem: What do we know about the Lester Bridges' dance studio?

choices.text: It is located in a big city in Iowa.
choices.zh: 它位于爱荷华州的一个大城市。

choices.text: It is really marvelous to look at.
choices.zh: 它看起来非常了不起。

choices.text: It offers free dance classes to seniors.
choices.zh: 它为老年人提供免费舞蹈课程。

choices.text: It offers people a chance to socialize.
choices.zh: 它为人们提供了社交的机会。

items.stem: What happened to the young couple after they attended Lester Bridges's class?

choices.text: Their state of mind improved.
choices.zh: 他们的精神状态得到了改善。

choices.text: They became better dancers.
choices.zh: 他们成为了更好的舞者。

choices.text: They enjoyed better health.
choices.zh: 他们享有了更好的健康状况。

choices.text: Their relationship strengthened.
choices.zh: 他们的关系得到了加强。

items.stem: What does Andrea Hillier say about dancing?

choices.text: It is fun.
choices.zh: 它很有趣。

choices.text: It is life.
choices.zh: 它就是生活。

choices.text: It is exhausting.
choices.zh: 它令人筋疲力尽。

choices.text: It is rhythmical.
choices.zh: 它富有节奏感。
